description: The signed-in person's past invoices with their PDF and document links (pdfUrl / documentUrl). Without filters it covers every billing identity of the person (personal VAT plus companies they own or administer); each invoice is tagged with its identity {kind, id, label, vatMasked}. identity ("all", "personal" or "org:<organisationId>") or identities (several of "personal" / "org:<organisationId>") narrow by identity; from/to (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) narrow by date; limit caps the count (1–50).
name: read_invoices
title: My invoices
